Read-only access (scope user:profile): the app can see your profile and usage, but not your chats, and it can\'t send messages.

While the app is open it refreshes every minute. In the background Android may delay updates to save battery, especially with the screen off. The usage API is rate-limited, so very short intervals don\'t pay off.
Android, and Samsung phones especially, may hold back widget updates for a long time.

• Signs in through claude.ai in your browser; the app never sees your password.
• Asks only for read access to your profile and usage (scope user:profile).
• Tokens are encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore, are never logged and never leave this phone: backups are off.
• Talks only to api.anthropic.com and platform.claude.com, over HTTPS.
• Keeps a usage history (percentages and reset times, 5 weeks) on this phone. Signing out deletes everything.
• No analytics, no ads, no other servers.
Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC.
